theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (ω η : TestFormOn U k) (χ f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t ε M : ℝ), Continuous f → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ≤ M) → (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, f x ≤ t - ε → χ x = 1) → (∀ x, t ≤ f x → χ x = 0) → |(∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) - ∫ x, ξ x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ| ≤ M * (μ (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ∩ {x | t - ε < f x ∧ f x < t})).toReal
